description: This file contains the implementation of the ODBTP database driver for the ADOdb PHP library, including the ADODB_odbtp class with methods for database connection, sequence management, error handling, and query execution, as well as various specialized record set classes for different database types.
external_files: odbtp.php (the external library providing ODBTP functions)

classes.name: ADODB_odbtp
classes.description: Main driver class implementing database connection, sequence management, and transaction methods for the ODBTP driver.

classes.name: ADODBRecordSet_odbtp
classes.description: Base record set class for the ODBTP driver, supporting data fetching and navigation.

classes.name: ADODBRecordSet_odbtp_mssql
classes.description: Specialized record set for MS SQL Server via ODBTP.

classes.name: ADODBRecordSet_odbtp_access
classes.description: Specialized record set for MS Access via ODBTP.

classes.name: ADODBRecordSet_odbtp_vfp
classes.description: Specialized record set for Visual FoxPro via ODBTP.

classes.name: ADODBRecordSet_odbtp_oci8
classes.description: Specialized record set for Oracle via ODBTP.

classes.name: ADODBRecordSet_odbtp_sybase
classes.description: Specialized record set for Sybase via ODBTP.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves server information such as description and version using ODBTP attributes.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message from ODBTP functions.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the last error code or state from ODBTP.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Fetches a list of database tables using a SQL query.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Gets metadata about table columns returning an array of field objects.

methods.name: MetaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Returns an array of primary key column names for a given table.

methods.name: metaForeignKeys
methods.description: Retrieves foreign key constraints for a specified table.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Starts a database transaction if supported.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a query with limit and offset, adjusting for specific driver requirements.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement and optionally binds input parameters.

methods.name: Parameter
methods.description: Binds a PHP variable to a prepared statement parameter.

methods.name: UpdateBlob
methods.description: Updates a blob field with binary data.

methods.name: MetaIndexes
methods.description: Fetches index information for a table, tailored for MSSQL.

methods.name: MetaIndexes_mssql
methods.description: Fetches index details specifically for MSSQL databases.

methods.name: IfNull
methods.description: Generates SQL for null coalescing depending on driver.
